# WeDeepen

> WeDeepen is an expert-led relationship education company based in Austin, Texas, founded by Christina Weber. Its premise is that love is a skill you can train. It offers a $99/month online membership with a live session every Tuesday, three-day Love Immersion retreats in Austin, Love Club (a $9,997/year inner circle), private coaching with Christina, and the Mastering Love podcast.

WeDeepen is for people who are dating, partnered, between relationships, or simply want to get better at love. Individuals and couples are both welcome; about half of every Love Immersion arrives solo. WeDeepen is relationship education and coaching, not therapy.

## Offerings and pricing

Prices below are as published on the linked pages. Dates and prices change; the linked pages are the source of truth.

- [WeDeepen Membership](https://wedeepen.com/): $99/month or $990/year (two months free); cancel anytime inside the Circle community. A 90-minute live session every Tuesday at 7:00 PM Eastern (6:00 PM Central), alternating Love Masterminds and Integration Sessions; a private community with Ask the Experts discussions on Circle; and a Sunday Dare each week by text and email. Love Masterminds are recorded from the time you join; Integration Sessions are live only. The first 20 annual members get an $800 credit toward one Love Immersion.
- [Love Immersion](https://wedeepen.com/love-immersion/): A three-day in-person retreat in Austin, TX with the full faculty. $2,995 per person, with a payment plan at checkout. Tickets are non-refundable but fully transferable.
- [Love Club](https://wedeepen.com/love-club/): WeDeepen's inner circle, $9,997/year. Includes everything in the Membership plus Friday Office Hours with Christina Weber (Fridays, 12 PM Central), Annie Lalla's 12-week "Learn How to Be in Love" program, a monthly Couples Council, Collaborative Matchmaking, one Love Immersion credit ($2,995, transferable to a partner), member-only invites, and a private Love Club community. Register with a partner and you each get $500 off. Full refund within 14 days of purchase.
- [Private coaching with Christina Weber](https://wedeepen.com/book-session-with-christina/): One-on-one or couples sessions on Zoom. A first session is $295, credited toward her 3-month Love Accelerator mentorship ($10,000) if you continue.

## What makes Love Immersion different

- Three full days, in person, in Austin: live "hot seat" coaching where people work on what they actually came with, connection exercises that land in the body rather than the head, and long stretches of unstructured time.
- Every retreat runs on the same Four Pillars: growth comes first with no attachment to outcome; you own your own experience; all feelings are welcome and no internal process is condemned; and the relationship is a place to practice love.
- No single teacher or modality. The faculty are senior leaders in their fields, chosen by Christina as her own mentors and the people she calls for guidance in her own love life.
- Come solo, with a partner, a friend, a sibling, or a parent. Participants have ranged from 18 to 87, most in their thirties through sixties. Relationship coaches attend as participants too.
- You do not need a partner, a breakup, or a crisis to come.

Upcoming retreats and their dates, venues, and schedules are listed on the [Love Immersion hub](https://wedeepen.com/love-immersion/).

## Founder: Christina Weber

Christina Weber is the founder and CEO of WeDeepen and an ICF-certified coach trained at iPEC. She began producing dating events in New York City in 2014 with Underground Unattached, and has since curated and produced dating, relationship, and intimacy events and festivals reaching more than 40,000 people. She hosts the Mastering Love podcast (formerly Deepen with Christina), with more than 180 episodes. Her work has appeared on the cover of LA Magazine, on Peacock's Ex-Rated with Andy Cohen, on Real Time with Bill Maher, and at Omega Institute. Her philanthropic initiative Feminine Weapon has raised more than $100,000 for children experiencing abuse, poverty, and trafficking. Her personal site is [christinalweber.com](https://christinalweber.com).

René Besson is WeDeepen's Managing Partner, after more than thirty years producing film and television.

## Faculty

WeDeepen's faculty (also called Love Strategists) are listed with full bios on the [Faculty page](https://wedeepen.com/love-guides/). They include:

- Christina Weber: founder; coach, speaker, and experience designer.
- Annie Lalla: philosopher and relationship coach, the "Cartographer of Love"; frameworks for conflict, commitment, and communication.
- Ken Page, LCSW: psychotherapist, author of Deeper Dating, and host of the Deeper Dating Podcast.
- Ariana Hall: transformation coach working between truth and tenderness.
- Yossef Sagi: Master Coach; intimacy, presence, and somatic attunement, drawing on Kabbalah and Tantra.
- Dana Arielle: feminine embodiment, pleasure, and devotion.
- Jordan Bowditch: polarity, radical play, and somatic coaching.

Each Love Immersion page names the faculty teaching that retreat.

## What WeDeepen is not

- Not therapy, and not a substitute for mental-health treatment. It is relationship education and coaching.
- Not a dating app or a matchmaking service. Love Club includes Collaborative Matchmaking with partner matchmakers, but WeDeepen itself is a place to learn and practice.
- Not only for couples, and not only for people in crisis.
- Not one method or one guru. The faculty teach different approaches, and members are not asked to commit to one way of thinking about love.
- The $99/month WeDeepen Membership and Love Club are two different products. Love Club includes the Membership; the Membership does not include Love Club.

## Podcast

The show is now called Mastering Love, formerly Deepen with Christina, hosted by Christina Weber. Long-form conversations with relationship experts, somatic practitioners, authors, and researchers on love, sex, dating, intimacy, and modern relationships.

- [Podcast home](https://wedeepen.com/podcast/): Search and browse episodes
